data.name: Star Titans : War of the Galaxy
data.detailed_description:
Star Titans: War of the Galaxy

Command your fleet and conquer the vast galaxy. Star Titans: War of the Galaxy is a turn-based sci-fi strategy simulation game that combines deep 4X gameplay with a webtoon-inspired space opera story. Explore unknown worlds, develop advanced technologies, expand your empire, and dominate the stars.

Build Your Own Fleet

Collect and develop over 100 unique ships and create your own strategic playstyle. Strengthen your fleet through ship upgrades, passive bonuses, and customizable modules including weapons, energy systems, and defensive equipment.

  • Ship upgrades and growth systems

  • Weapon, energy, and defense modules

  • Deep ship customization options

  • Strategic combinations for different playstyles

Explore and Expand the Galaxy

Discover mysterious star systems and establish your galactic empire through the core principles of 4X gameplay:

  • Explore unknown sectors

  • Expand your territory

  • Exploit resources and opportunities

  • Exterminate your enemies

Claim the galaxy and shape its future.

Research and Evolve

Advance your civilization through five unique technology trees.

  • Unlock new technologies

  • Upgrade fleet capabilities

  • Develop strategic advantages

  • Build increasingly powerful forces

Tactical Turn-Based Battles

Experience simple-to-learn yet strategically engaging combat.

  • Fast-paced turn-based encounters

  • Nearby units provide random support attacks

  • Dynamic battles that reward tactical thinking

Build Your Space Empire

Construct structures and develop your territory across the galaxy.

  • Build structures within your domain

  • Create special facilities on stars, gas planets, comets, and ice asteroids

  • Expand production and strengthen your infrastructure

Conquer Planets

Deploy fleets to neutral and enemy planets and expand your influence.

  • Capture and control planets

  • Secure valuable resources

  • Gain strategic benefits and services

  • Expand your galactic dominance

Star Titan Ship – The Ultimate Mobile Fortress

The Star Titan Ship is more than just a battleship.

  • Mobile command headquarters

  • Ship production facility

  • Strategic operations center

  • Fire devastating beam weapons

Lead your fleet, forge your own destiny, and become the ruler of the galaxy.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 Home 64 Bit (version 21H1)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2500K or AMD® Ryzen™ 5 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 670 (2GB) or AMD® Radeon™ HD 7870 (2GB) or Intel® Arc™ A380 (6GB) or Intel® Iris™ Xe G7 (Tiger Lake) or AMD® Radeon™ Vega 8
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 920 MB available space
